stage.name: Night Champion Show
stage.description:
A corporation in Kazimierz is planning an unusual game show. Participants must fend off wave after wave of knight attacks in order to claim the grand prize. Rhodes Island has been invited as a contestant. 
<Special Conditions> DP will not regenerate naturally. 
<City Neon> Provides an initial amount of visibility, and can further increase visibility when used

nameless_independent_knight.name: Nameless Independent Knight
nameless_independent_knight.flavourText: An independent Kazimierz knight. A low profile and unrefined skill means this one will soon be swept away in the tide of knight competition.

undertide_gloompincer_enemy_1178_dscorp.name: Undertide Gloompincer
undertide_gloompincer_enemy_1178_dscorp.flavourText: A Gloompincer that escaped from the arenas and adapted to life in the city's sewers. It has grown used to the darkness and has increased Movement Speed under the cover of night.
abilities: When in areas with no visibility, Movement Speed increases

roar_knightclub_trainee.name: Roar Knightclub Trainee
roar_knightclub_trainee.flavourText: Wearing the high-performance, lightweight armor provided by Roar Guards, this new batch of experimental armor has some humorous deficiencies that made these people into pitiful test subjects. 'Roar Guards, even the winds will bow to you!'
abilities: Has significantly increased DEF and RES for a period of time

armorless_union_assassin.name: Armorless Union Assassin
armorless_union_assassin.flavourText: An assassin hired by the Armorless Union, making up for their average skills with clever plots. They are adept at hiding in the darkness, sharpening their blades and continually increasing their ATK.
abilities: When in areas with no visibility, ATK continuously increases, and resets after the next attack

armorless_union_crossbowman.name: Armorless Union Crossbowman
armorless_union_crossbowman.flavourText: A crossbowman hired by the Armorless Union, lurking in the city's shadows. They are adept at hiding in the darkness and assassinating their targets with special bolts.
abilities: When in areas with no visibility, attacks deal Arts damage

training_gloompincer.name: Training Gloompincer
training_gloompincer.flavourText: Infected creatures commonly found in the great lakes and rivers of Kazimierz, captured and raised by casters and used as tools to train knights and entertain fight spectators.

bloodboil_knightclub_trainee.name: Bloodboil Knightclub Trainee
bloodboil_knightclub_trainee.flavourText: A trainee from the Bloodboil Knightclub. The Bloodboil Knights have long been known for their ferocity and aggression, from trainees to knight nobles. Whenever one of their brothers falls, they gain courage and combat prowess.
abilities: Each time an enemy is defeated, gains ATK and ASPD, stacking up to 10 times.

nova_knightclub_trainee.name: Nova Knightclub Trainee
nova_knightclub_trainee.flavourText: A trainee of the Nova Knightclub. With the Candle Knight as its figurehead, this Knightclub with a beautiful name recruits elegant knights proficient in using Arts from far and wide. Though there is occasional displeasure over being forced to imitate the Candle Knight, the popularity and wealth it brings remain a big draw of the Knightclub.
abilities: [Glimmering Touch] After charging for some time, deals a large amount of Arts damage to a target and all surrounding units
While charging, loses Invisibility

armorless_union_cleanup_squad_leader.name: Armorless Union Cleanup Squad Leader
armorless_union_cleanup_squad_leader.flavourText: A leader of the cleanup squad personally trained by Roy. They lead the squad in place of Roy, who refuses to work, and are very experienced. The squad has adopted some kind of bounty system and is often very thorough in their tasks. Their attacks inflict Corrosion.
abilities: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

nightzmora_imitator.name: Nightzmora Imitator
nightzmora_imitator.flavourText: Pretenders who began following Nightmare Knight after his battles and 'Performance Art'. Though the form is true, the substance is lacking. Perhaps they can be considered a type of fan as well.
abilities: [Coalescing Fear] Deals Physical damage to all operators with no visibility directly behind them

left_hand_tytus_topola.name: 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola
left_hand_tytus_topola.flavourText: His nose is high as the sun, and he's almost as terrifyingly strong, if much, much colder. And look how many fans have lined up for him! He's 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola! He weakens his enemies' resolve, crushes their spirit, sneering down at them as they fall to their knees in surrender. That's a Left-handed victory!
abilities: Significantly decreases ATK of the unit with the highest ATK for a period of time
Rebirth

the_blood_knight_dikaiopolis.name: The Blood Knight Dikaiopolis
the_blood_knight_dikaiopolis.flavourText: The Blood Knight, Dikaiopolis. The originator of Kazimierz's Infected Knight program, the hero of the Grand Knight Territory's Infected, and an idol to countless children. What exactly did the 'hero' give up to obtain the peace we know today?
abilities: Reduce damage taken, but damage reduction does not work on units blocking it
First Form
[Exsanguination] Stuns the target, dealing Arts damage every second
Resurrection Stance
Blood Knight is invulnerable and continuously summons <Bloodblades>; enters the Second Form after some time
[Resurrection Stance] If the Blood Knight's HP is restored to its maximum while in this stance, he will return to his first form
Second Form
Gains increased ATK and attacks become ranged
Continuously summons <Bloodblades>

bloodblade.name: Bloodblade
bloodblade.flavourText: Blood that bows to the will of the Blood Knight, re-animating and coagulating into the shape of a sharp blade.
abilities: After coming into contact with the <Blood Knight>, disappears and restores a certain amount of the <Blood Knight's> HP

devices.description: Provides visibility to the four adjacent tiles
devices.name: City Neon
